4008.desc: A delicate elf that lacks offense, but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.

4232.desc: Swift and deadly, this monster grabs victims with its claws and attacks with a poison stinger.

4317.desc: Increase the ATK of a monster equipped with this card by 500 points. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

4372.desc: These walls form a labyrinth with no exit for enemies.

4483.desc: A stag beetle with a saw-like head and arms.

4492.desc: A book-like wizard with a wealth of spells written inside.

4546.desc: FLIP: You can draw 1 card from your Deck.

4556.desc: With an enormous maw and massive teeth, this monstrosity is one dangerous and strange serpent from the deep.

4564.desc: A not-so-powerful servant, he is an errand boy of a master sorcerer.

4601.desc: This monster can draw its enemies into a mirror world that renders them helpless.

4639.desc: Legend has it that this creature can foretell the birth of children.

4733.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned while "Toon World" is on your side of the field. You can Special Summon this monster from your hand, but Tributes are required for monsters Level 5 or more. This card cannot attack in the turn that it is Summoned. Unless you pay 500 Life Points, this monster cannot attack. When "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, this card is also destroyed. If your opponent doesn't control a Toon Monster, this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly. If a face-up Toon Monster is on your opponent's side of the field, you must select the Toon Monster as an attack target.

4737.desc: Select 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field and equip it to this card (this effect can only be used once per turn and you can only equip 1 monster at a time to this card). The ATK and DEF of this card become the same amounts as the monster equipped to this card. If this card is destroyed as a result of battle, the equipped monster is destroyed instead, and any Battle Damage you received from the battle is also inflicted to your opponent's Life Points.

4743.desc: A dragon created from a massive diamond that sparkles with blinding light.

4750.desc: When this card is Summoned successfully, place 1 Spell Counter on it (maximum of 1). Remove the Spell Counter to destroy one face-up Trap Card in the field.

4773.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned while "Toon World" is on your side of the field. You can Special Summon this monster from your hand, but Tributes are required for monsters Level 5 or more. This card cannot attack in the turn that it is Summoned. Unless you pay 500 Life Points, this monster cannot attack. When "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, this card is also destroyed. If your opponent doesn't control a Toon Monster, this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly. If a face-up Toon Monster is on your opponent's side of the field, you must select the Toon Monster as an attack target.

4805.desc: Tribute 1 face-up "Kuriboh". Special Summon as many "Kuriboh Tokens" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 200) as possible in Defense Position on your side of the field. The tokens cannot be used as a Tribute for a Tribute Summon.

4922.desc: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, increase your Life Points by 1000 points. You can also Special Summon up to 2 "Nimble Momonga" cards from your Deck to your side of the field in face-down Defense Position. Then shuffle your Deck.

5003.desc:
"Baby Dragon" + "Alligator's Sword"
You can inflict Direct Damage to your opponent's Life Points with this card if the only Attributes of Monster Cards on your opponent's side of the field are EARTH, WATER, or FIRE.

5024.desc: As long as this card remains in face-up Defense Position on the field, increase the ATK and DEF of all Plant-Type monsters on your side of the field by 500 points.

5096.desc: If this monster is Normal Summoned, destroy this card. If your opponent controls any monster, decrease the ATK of this card by 200 points for each monster on your opponent's side of the field.

5184.desc: You can only activate this card when there are "Don Zaloog" and "Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn" face-up on your side of the field. Send 1 "Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn" from your side of your field to the Graveyard to destroy all of your opponent's monsters.

5189.desc: When a "Winged Kuriboh" on your side of the field is destroyed, you can add this card from your Deck to your hand. Pay half of your Life Points to add 1 card from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. After this card is activated, it is placed into the Deck. Then shuffle the Deck. After you use this effect 3 times, this card takes on the following effect. Select 1 face-up monster on your side of the field and multiply its ATK by the number of monsters on your opponent's side of the field until this turn's End Phase.

5230.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned from your hand or your Deck by offering 1 "Dark Magician" on your side of the field as a Tribute when you succeed in the effect of "Time Wizard". At that time, select 1 Spell Card from your Deck, add it to your hand, and then shuffle your Deck.

5231.desc: The controller of this card can activate Traps on the turn they are set. Additionally, by sending this card and "Mystical Beast Serket" to the Graveyard when they are on your side of the field, you may select one Monster Card from your hand, Deck, or Fusion Deck and Special Summon it.

5242.desc: This card is destroyed unless you have "Cathedral of Nobles" on your side of the field. Each time this card destroys a monster in battle, that monster is removed from play, and this card receives a 500 point ATK bonus.

5266.desc: Select 1 monster face-up on the field. Increase the selected monster's ATK by 100 points for each monster in your Graveyard during the turn this card is activated. The number of monster(s) is applied when this card is activated.

5290.desc: Destroys all face-up Spell Cards controlled by your opponent on the field. For each Spell Card destroyed, your opponent receives 500 damage.

5358.desc: Offer each of your monsters on the field as a Tribute (except Tokens). For each card offered as a Tribute, your opponent selects a Spell Card from their Deck, sends it to the Graveyard, and afterwards shuffles their Deck.

5367.desc: Special Summons one Normal Monster from your Graveyard in face-up Defense Position. While that monster is on the field, it cannot attack.

5414.desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up, destroy all face-up monsters on the field except this card.

5451.desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned with 3 Tributes, all monsters on your opponent's side of the field are destroyed.

5483.desc: If this card is face-up on your side of the field and is destroyed by the effect of an opponent's card and sent to the Graveyard, it will be Special Summoned to your side of the field on your next Standby Phase.

5493.desc: Can be activated when your opponent's monster attacks. Destroys all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

5497.desc: Can be activated when your opponent attacks during their Battle Step. Returns 1 monster on your side of the field to your hand and Special Summons one Level 4 monster from your hand.

5501.desc:
"Black Luster Soldier" + "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon"
This monster can only be Special Summoned with a Fusion Summon. For each Dragon monster on your side of the field, not including this one, this card receives a 500 point ATK bonus.

5502.desc: This card can only be Special Summoned with a Fusion Summon. This card is Fusion Summoned with 5 Dragon monsters. This card does not take Battle Damage from EARTH, WATER, FIRE, WIND, or DARK monsters.

5557.desc: Can be activated when a monster on your side of the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard. Pay 1000 Life Points to Special Summon one Level 4 monster from your Deck.

5561.desc: When this card causes Battle Damage to your opponent, they must send the topmost card from their Deck to the Graveyard. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, you can choose one Zombie-Type card with a DEF of 1200 or less from your Deck and show it to your opponent before adding it to your hand. The Deck is then shuffled.

5632.desc: Special Summons one "Metal Fiend Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) to your side of the field. This Token cannot attack. Excess damage against the Controller from battle with "Metal Fiend Token" is received by your opponent instead. Pay 1000 Life Points during your Standby Phase. If you do not pay 1000 Life Points, the "Metal Fiend Token" is destroyed.

5688.desc: Discard 2 cards from your hand to return one Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

5743.desc: Destroys 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field. Your opponent receives 1000 Life Points when a monster is destroyed by this effect.

5753.desc:
Pay half of your Life Points. Select and Activate the effects which can be applied and fulfills the following conditions.
●If "Yu-Jo Friendship" is in your Graveyard, your opponent player cannot Set, Normal Summon, Flip Summon, Special Summon a monster(s) or activate an effect of an Effect Monster until the end of this turn. 
●If "Unity" is in your Graveyard, negate a Spell or Trap Card(s) on your opponent's side of the field and also your opponent cannot activate or Set a Spell or Trap Card(s) until the end of the turn.

5890.desc: By Tributing 1 Insect-Type monster on your side of the field, inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

5896.desc: By Tributing 1 "Torpedo Fish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 monster on the field. By Tributing 1 "Cannonball Spear Shellfish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

5943.desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned, you may throw the dice once. The ATK of this card increases by 200 times the value of the dice as long as it remains in face-up position on the field.

5944.desc: Roll a die during each of your Standby Phases. Apply the effect that matches the number rolled as follows: 1) You discard one card from your hand. 2) Your opponent discards one card from their Hand. 3) You draw one card. 4) Your opponent draws a card. 5) Destroy one card on your opponent's side of the field. 6) Destroy this card.

5971.desc: While there is a Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, this card cannot be attacked. By Tributing 1 Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

6001.desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. When the effects of an Effect Monster are activated, this card must be given in Tribute if it is face-up on the field. It cancels the activation and effects of the Effect Monster, destroying it.

6003.desc: Select 1 monster in Defense Position on the field and destroy it.

6005.desc: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard and you have no cards in your hand, you may add this card to your hand by paying 500 Life Points.

6006.desc:
Select one of the following effects:
●Draw one card from your Deck.
●Draw 2 cards from your Deck. (This effect can only be activated when there is a Spirit Monster face-up on your opponent's side of the field.)

6007.desc: While this card and "Marshmallon" are face-up on your side of the field, your opponent cannot attack any card except "Marshmallon".
6007.name: Marshmallon Glasses

6043.desc: By Tributing 1 Normal Monster (except a Token) on your side of the field, inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

6076.desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. By paying half your Life Points you can destroy all the cards on the field except this one, removing them from the game. For each card destroyed by this effect, the ATK of this card increases by 300 points. This card is sent to the Graveyard during the End Phase of the turn in which it was Summoned/Flip Summoned.

6142.desc: As long as a monster(s) remain(s) on your side of the field, Battle Damage to you becomes 0.

6150.desc: This card can be Special Summoned from your hand by discarding one other card from your hand.

6158.desc: Activate by sending one "The Tricky" card that is face up on your field to the Graveyard. When activating this card, only the monsters that are in your opponent's field are Special Summoned in Defense Position as "Tricky Tokens" (Spellcaster-Type/WIND/Level 5/ATK 2000/DEF 1200). These Tokens cannot declare an attack.

6229.desc: This card is not destroyed as a result of battle. If this card is in face-up Attack Position on your side of the field, Tributing 1 monster on your side of the field that is Level 5 or below will inflict damage equal to the Tributed monster's original ATK to your opponent's Life Points. This effect can only be used once per turn.

6231.desc: Control of each monster on the field returns to its original owner.

6265.desc:
"Lord of D." + "Divine Dragon Ragnarok"
Your opponent cannot select any Dragon-Type monsters as the target(s) of Spell, Trap, or Monster Card effects. Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand.

6277.desc:
When your opponent has 4 cards in their hand, select and activate 1 of these effects:
●Your opponent cannot draw during their next Draw Phase.
●Your opponent cannot activate any Spell or Trap Cards this turn.

6287.desc: When this card is destroyed in battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can pay 500 Life Points and Special Summon it to your side of the field during the Standby Phase of the next turn. When this card is successfully Special Summoned using this effect, its ATK increases by 500 points.

6288.desc: Activate by selecting 1 monster face-up on your side of the field. During the Battle Phase of this turn, the selected monster's ATK is increased in an amount equal to the total ATK of every other monster face-up in Attack Position on your side of the field. This monster cannot inflict Battle Damage against your opponent. Additionally, other monsters in face-up Attack Position cannot attack.

6289.desc: Each time you inflict Battle Damage on your opponent with this card, the top card of your opponent's Deck is sent to the Graveyard.

6291.desc: Activate by selecting 1 Zombie-Type monster with 2000 ATK or less on your side of the field. The selected monster will be able to directly attack your opponent during the turn.

6302.desc: If there is no monster on your side of the field when you Normal Summon this card, you can Special Summon a monster that includes "Machiners" in its name other than "Machiners Soldier" from your hand.

6400.desc: This card cannot be given as a Tribute. When this card is successfully Summoned or Flip Summoned, it appears on the field in Defense Position. By discarding one Spell Card from your hand you can Special Summon one Level 4 Monster Card from your Deck. The Monster Card Special Summoned using this effect cannot attack for the duration of the turn. You can only activate the effect of this card once each turn, during your Main Phase.

6405.desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. It can only be Summoned by giving 3 Monster Cards on your side of the field as Tributes. While this card remains on the field in face-up position the ATK and DEF of all other Monster Cards on the field are reduced by half.

6410.desc:
This card can be Special Summoned from your hand after you have cancelled the effects of a card controlled by your opponent using a Counter Trap Card. When this card is successfully Special Summoned in this way, the following effects are activated, depending on the cards whose effects were originally cancelled.
●Spell : reduce your opponent's Life Points by 1500.
●Trap : choose one card on your opponent's side of the field and destroy it.
●Effect Monster : choose one card from your Graveyard and Special Summon it to your side of the field.

6450.desc: By paying 1000 Life Points you can destroy all Monster Cards in face-up position on the field and prevent any cards of the same type from being Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned.

6454.desc:
"Queen's Knight" + "Jack's Knight" + "King's Knight"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. While this card remains on the field in face-up position, you can cancel the effect of Spell, Trap, and Effect Monster Cards by discarding a card of the same type from your hand (any Monster Card can be discarded to cancel the effect of an Effect Monster Card). This effect can only be used once per turn.

6539.desc: You can only activate this card when an "Elemental Hero Clayman" on your side of the field is selected as an attack target. (If it is face-down, pick up and show the card to your opponent.) Destroy the attacking monster and the selected "Elemental Hero Clayman" to inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

6636.desc: You can add one "Kuriboh" or "Winged Kuriboh" to your hand or Special Summon them to your side of the field from your Deck.

6639.desc:
"Elemental Hero Avian" + "Elemental Hero Burstinatrix" + "Elemental Hero Clayman" + "Elemental Hero Bubbleman"
This monster cannot be Special Summoned except by Fusion Summon. The Attribute of this card is also treated as WIND, WATER, FIRE, and EARTH. When this card is successfully Fusion Summoned, all cards that have been removed from the game are returned to their owner's Deck and the Deck is shuffled. For each Monster Card with the same attribute as this card on your opponent's side of the field, the ATK of this card increases by 300 points.

6640.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 monster on your side of the field that includes "Sphinx" in its card name. While this card is face-up on the field, each time an EARTH monster is Flip Summoned, inflict 1000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

6648.desc: This card can be Tribute Summoned by giving one "Helios Duo Megistus" card from your side of the field as a Tribute. The ATK and DEF of this card are equal to the total of the number of Monster Cards that have been removed from the game x 300. If this card is destroyed in battle and sent to the Graveyard, it is automatically Special Summoned in the End Phase and its ATK/DEF increase by 500 points. If your opponent has Monster Cards on the field at the time, this card can attack them once more.

6684.desc:
When this card destroys an opponent's monster as a result of battle, select and activate 1 of the following effects:
●Increase the ATK of this card by 400 points.
●Destroy 1 face-up Spell or Trap Card on the field.
●Special Summon 1 "Option Token" to your side of the field. It always has the same Type, Attribute, Level, ATK and DEF as this card.

6690.desc: While this card is face-up on the field, draw 1 card from your Deck each time a Counter Trap Card is activated.
